response.text: {"label": "protocol_misunderstanding", "reason": "The testbench treats the active-high rst as active-low: it releases rst at 200 ns and then drives it back high at 400 ns, sending both frames while uart_rx is held in reset. The submission log therefore shows only `1 204000 rx prescale 5`, with no busy_rise, frame_error or overrun_error, whereas gold has `3 35000 rx busy_rise 0`, `154 1545000 rx frame_error 1` and `230 2305000 rx overrun_error 1`."}
